name: 锁等待/死锁诊断
description: PostgreSQL 使用多级锁机制保护并发访问：行级锁（FOR UPDATE/FOR SHARE）、表级锁（8 种模式从 AccessShareLock 到 AccessExclusiveLock）、页级锁、Advisory 锁。当锁等待时间过长或发生死锁时，表现为查询延迟飙升、pg_stat_activity 中大量 waiting 状态、日志中出现 deadlock detected 记录。需要区分锁类型和根因才能正确处理。

signals.desc: pg_stat_activity 中 wait_event_type = 'Lock' 的会话数量持续偏高
应用端频繁收到 ERROR: canceling statement due to lock timeout
日志出现 ERROR: deadlock detected
pg_stat_activity 中锁等待会话的 wait_event_type='Lock' 持续时间过长

conditions.desc: 同时有 > 5 个会话在等待锁
存在被阻塞 > 30 秒的会话
最近 1 小时出现死锁记录

skip_when.desc: 锁等待 < 3 个会话且持续时间 < 5 秒，属于正常短暂竞争
仅 Advisory Lock 等待，非表/行级锁问题

root_causes.name: 长事务持有 AccessExclusiveLock（DDL 阻塞）
root_causes.desc: ALTER TABLE、DROP TABLE、TRUNCATE、REINDEX、VACUUM FULL 等 DDL 需要 AccessExclusiveLock，与所有其他锁模式冲突。在高峰期执行这些操作会阻塞该表上的所有读写。更危险的是 DDL 在等待获取锁时，后续所有查询也会排队（锁队列公平性），造成雪崩效应。

root_causes.name: 热行竞争（Row-level lock contention）
root_causes.desc: 多个事务并发更新同一行（如计数器、余额、库存），后到的事务必须等先到的提交或回滚。如果事务持有行锁的时间过长（事务内包含外部调用、复杂计算），等待链会快速增长。

root_causes.name: 死锁（Deadlock）
root_causes.desc: 两个或多个事务互相等待对方持有的锁，形成循环依赖。PostgreSQL 的死锁检测器（deadlock_timeout 默认 1 秒后触发）会选择一个事务回滚打破循环。频繁死锁说明应用的锁获取顺序不一致。

root_causes.name: 未提交事务长时间持锁
root_causes.desc: idle in transaction 状态的会话仍然持有事务开始以来获取的所有锁。常见于应用连接池回收不当、ORM 未正确关闭事务、交互式 psql 会话忘记 COMMIT。

root_causes.name: 外键约束导致隐式锁
root_causes.desc: UPDATE/DELETE 父表时 PostgreSQL 需要检查子表的外键约束，会在子表上获取 RowShareLock。如果子表同时有大量写入，可能产生意外的锁竞争。批量删除父表记录时尤为明显。

step1_blocking_chain.desc: 查看当前的锁等待链（谁阻塞了谁）
step1_blocking_chain.sql: SELECT blocked_locks.pid AS blocked_pid, blocked_activity.usename AS blocked_user, blocking_locks.pid AS blocking_pid, blocking_activity.usename AS blocking_user, blocked_activity.query AS blocked_query, blocking_activity.query AS blocking_query, blocked_locks.locktype, blocked_locks.mode AS blocked_mode, blocking_locks.mode AS blocking_mode, blocked_activity.state AS blocked_state, blocking_activity.state AS blocking_state, now() - blocked_activity.query_start AS blocked_duration FROM pg_locks blocked_locks JOIN pg_stat_activity blocked_activity ON blocked_activity.pid = blocked_locks.pid JOIN pg_locks blocking_locks ON blocking_locks.locktype = blocked_locks.locktype AND blocking_locks.database IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.database AND blocking_locks.relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.relation AND blocking_locks.page IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.page AND blocking_locks.tuple IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.tuple AND blocking_locks.virtualxid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.virtualxid AND blocking_locks.transactionid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.transactionid AND blocking_locks.classid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.classid AND blocking_locks.objid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.objid AND blocking_locks.objsubid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.objsubid AND blocking_locks.pid != blocked_locks.pid JOIN pg_stat_activity blocking_activity ON blocking_activity.pid = blocking_locks.pid WHERE NOT blocked_locks.granted ORDER BY blocked_duration DESC

step2_lock_summary.desc: 按锁类型和模式汇总当前锁情况
step2_lock_summary.sql: SELECT locktype, mode, COUNT(*) AS lock_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT granted) AS waiting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE granted) AS granted FROM pg_locks GROUP BY locktype, mode HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT granted) > 0 ORDER BY waiting DESC

step3_table_lock_detail.desc: 查看特定表上的锁详情
step3_table_lock_detail.sql: SELECT l.pid, l.mode, l.granted, a.usename, a.state, a.query_start, now() - a.query_start AS duration, LEFT(a.query, 150) AS query FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE l.relation = '{table_oid}'::oid ORDER BY l.granted, a.query_start

step4_deadlock_log.desc: 从日志检查最近的死锁记录（需要 log_lock_waits = on）
step4_deadlock_log.note: 需要在日志文件中搜索 'deadlock detected'。建议设置 log_lock_waits = on 记录超过 deadlock_timeout 的锁等待

step5_idle_in_transaction.desc: 找出 idle in transaction 的会话（可能无谓持锁）
step5_idle_in_transaction.sql: SELECT pid, usename, datname, state, now() - xact_start AS xact_duration, now() - state_change AS idle_duration, LEFT(query, 150) AS last_query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' ORDER BY xact_duration DESC

step6_row_lock_check.desc: 检查行级锁等待（tuple 级别的锁）
step6_row_lock_check.sql: SELECT l.pid, l.relation::regclass, l.tuple, l.mode, a.usename, a.state, LEFT(a.query, 150) AS query, now() - a.query_start AS wait_duration FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE l.locktype = 'tuple' AND NOT l.granted ORDER BY wait_duration DESC

step7_advisory_locks.desc: 检查 Advisory 锁使用情况
step7_advisory_locks.sql: SELECT l.pid, l.classid, l.objid, l.mode, l.granted, a.usename, a.state, LEFT(a.query, 100) AS query FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE l.locktype = 'advisory' ORDER BY l.granted, l.pid

step8_lock_wait_settings.sql: SELECT name, setting, unit FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('deadlock_timeout', 'lock_timeout', 'statement_timeout', 'idle_in_transaction_session_timeout', 'log_lock_waits', 'max_locks_per_transaction')

steps.sql: SELECT blocking_pid, COUNT(*) AS blocked_count FROM (SELECT blocked_locks.pid, blocking_locks.pid AS blocking_pid FROM pg_locks blocked_locks JOIN pg_locks blocking_locks ON blocking_locks.locktype = blocked_locks.locktype AND blocking_locks.relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM blocked_locks.relation AND blocking_locks.pid != blocked_locks.pid WHERE NOT blocked_locks.granted AND blocking_locks.granted) sub GROUP BY blocking_pid ORDER BY blocked_count DESC LIMIT 5

steps.action: 查看阻塞源头的详细信息
steps.sql: SELECT pid, usename, datname, state, LEFT(query, 200) AS query, now() - xact_start AS xact_duration, now() - query_start AS query_duration FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid IN ({blocking_pids})

steps.action: 如果阻塞源是 idle in transaction，直接终止
如果阻塞源是正在执行的 DDL，评估后决定是否终止
steps.note: pg_cancel_backend 先尝试取消查询，如果无效再用 pg_terminate_backend 终止连接

steps.action: 确认阻塞清除后设置保护参数
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET lock_timeout = '10s'; ALTER SYSTEM SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '5min'; ALTER SYSTEM SET log_lock_waits = 'on'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();
steps.risk: lock_timeout 会导致等待超时的语句失败
steps.rollback: ALTER SYSTEM RESET lock_timeout; ALTER SYSTEM RESET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

version_specific_notes.12: 支持 pg_blocking_pids() 函数快速查找阻塞 PID。log_lock_waits 记录超过 deadlock_timeout 的等待
version_specific_notes.13: 改进了并行 VACUUM 的锁机制。新增 idle_session_timeout 参数（注意与 idle_in_transaction_session_timeout 的区别）
version_specific_notes.14: 新增 pg_stat_progress_copy 用于监控 COPY 进度。idle_session_timeout 可设置为非事务空闲超时
version_specific_notes.15: MERGE 语句引入，其锁行为与 INSERT ON CONFLICT 不同，需要注意。pg_locks 新增 waitstart 列显示开始等待时间
version_specific_notes.16: pg_locks 的 waitstart 字段改进。新增非空闲事务超时相关的日志改进。改进的死锁检测日志包含更多上下文
version_specific_notes.17: 锁管理性能改进，减少锁哈希表的竞争。改进死锁日志的 JSON 格式输出。VACUUM 锁行为优化

real_world_examples.scenario: 高峰期 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 导致业务中断 15 分钟
real_world_examples.symptoms: 运维在高峰期执行 ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN status_v2 TEXT，DDL 等待一个长查询释放锁，期间所有 orders 表的查询（含 SELECT）全部排队
real_world_examples.root_cause: DDL 排队等待 AccessExclusiveLock 时，锁队列公平性机制导致后续所有查询也排队在 DDL 后面
real_world_examples.resolution: 取消 DDL，设置 lock_timeout = '3s' 后在低峰期重试。后续建立规范：所有 DDL 必须带 lock_timeout
real_world_examples.result: DDL 在低峰期 50ms 内完成，无业务影响

real_world_examples.scenario: 秒杀系统库存扣减死锁频发
real_world_examples.symptoms: 秒杀活动期间日志每分钟 10+ 条 deadlock detected，部分用户看到下单失败
real_world_examples.root_cause: 多个商品的库存扣减在同一事务中执行，不同事务获取行锁的顺序不一致
real_world_examples.resolution: 将同一事务中的库存扣减按 product_id 排序后执行，确保所有事务按相同顺序获取行锁
real_world_examples.result: 死锁从每分钟 10+ 降至 0，秒杀成功率提升至 99.8%
